objective: Freeze versioned transfer lifecycle and conservation oracles for A4 implementation; do not implement runtime behavior in this contract packet.
steps: Specify the versioned operation envelope, monotone state transitions, authoritative owner, resource release points and explicit compensation behavior.
Define per-event person, episode, ownership, reservation, occupancy and claim conservation oracles, including cancellation and expiry boundaries.
List executable positive, negative, tie, duplicate, reorder, delayed-ack and checkpoint/restart cases for A4.2, including explicit claim limits.
Run packet validation and diff checks; request reviewer-agent contract review before acceptance.

verification.oracle: Bound packet has no validation errors at the exact base and input hashes.

acceptance: ADR-0012 defines version, state machine, ownership and resource-release rules without prescribing unsupported engine behavior.

Post-departure rejection, in-flight deadline and compensation preserve the unique person/episode and authoritative owner.
